title: Run your whole company from one place
description: Your executive assistant for the grunt work: meetings, inbox, customers, and hiring.
introduction: As a founder you're head of sales, head of recruiting, head of fundraising, and the person who fixes the printer. Most days you'd give a lot for an executive assistant who could take the grunt work off your hands.

Strawberry can be that assistant. It's a free browser with an AI companion built in, working in your inbox, calendar, and every web app you use. And because every conversation can go into your team workspace, it gets sharper at your company over time.

items.title: Why a browser, not a chatbot

blocks.text: Not sure where to start? Strawberry is free to download. Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing worth handing over.

blocks.text: Calls are recorded without a bot and saved as shared context for your team.

sections.title: Why a browser, not a chatbot

blocks.text: Chatbots help you think. Strawberry does the work in your apps.

items: Uses your inbox, calendar, and CRM directly.
Works across many tabs at once.
Everything it learns can be shared with your team.

blocks.text: In our test of 12 real-world tasks, Strawberry scored 99.2 out of 100. Perplexity's Comet scored 90.8 and ChatGPT Atlas 73.3.

items: Review contracts, decks, and specs, with questions and suggested edits.
Prepare a fundraise: investors who back similar companies, a target list, updates, and the deck.
Get a daily brief of meetings, open threads, and what changed.
Turn research into a beautiful deck.

blocks.text: Everything you teach Strawberry stays with the company. Keep a shared companion in the team workspace, and every new hire starts with months of context on day one.
